card.statement:
The Poisson center $Z\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}]$ coincides with the ring of invariants $\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}]^{G}$ , and a theorem of Kostant states that there exists a natural isomorphism $i_{0}:\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}]\otimes_{Z\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}]}\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{N}]$ . In fact $(\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}],Z\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}],i_{0})$ is a flat graded Poisson deformation of $\mathcal{N}$ .

Similarly if $e\in\mathfrak{g}$ is a nilpotent element then restriction $\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}]^{G}\to\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{S}_{\chi}]$ provides an isomorphism to the Poisson center of functions on the Slodowy slice (see [ACET23, Lem. 3.3] for references) and, by a result of Premet [Pr02, Thm. 5.2], there is a natural Poisson isomorphism $i_{\chi}:\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{S}_{\chi}]\otimes_{Z\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}]}\mathbb{C}\to\mathcal{N}_{\chi}$ . In this case $(\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{S}_{\chi}],Z\mathbb{C}[\mathfrak{g}^{*}],i_{\chi})$ is a flat graded Poisson deformation of the central fiber $\mathcal{N}_{\chi}$ .

13.3. The functor of equivariant quantizations

Recall that the Poisson bracket on $\mathbb{C}[X]$ lies in some fixed degree $w>0$ , (13.3).

A filtered quantization (of a flat graded Poisson deformation) of $\mathbb{C}[X]$ is a triple $(\mathcal{A},B,i)$ with:

•

$\mathcal{A}$ a non-negatively filtered almost commutative algebra $\mathcal{A}=\bigcup_{j\geqslant 0}\mathcal{A}_{j}$ , such that $[\mathcal{A}_{j_{1}},\mathcal{A}_{j_{2}}]\subseteq\mathcal{A}_{j_{1}+j_{2}-w}$ . It follows that $\operatorname{gr}\mathcal{A}$ admits a Poisson bracket is graded in degree $-w$ ;

•

$B$ is a split filtered commutative algebra, i.e. $\operatorname{gr}B\cong B$ , admitting a map $B\to\mathcal{A}$ to the center of $\mathcal{A}$ . Thus $B\to\operatorname{gr}\mathcal{A}$ maps to the Poisson center;

•

$(\operatorname{gr}\mathcal{A},B,i)$ is a flat graded Poisson deformation of $\mathbb{C}[X]$ .

We call $B$ the base of the quantization. It is not hard to see that the map $B\to\mathcal{A}$ gives an isomorphism to the center.

Write SFAlg for the category of split filtered commutative algebras, i.e. filtered algebras satisfying $\operatorname{gr}B\cong B$ . The functor of filtered quantizations of $X$

(13.6)

$\displaystyle\operatorname{Q}_{X}:\textbf{SFAlg}\longrightarrow\textbf{Set}$

sends a split filtered graded commutative algebra $B$ to the set of isomorphism classes of filtered quantizations of $\mathbb{C}[X]$ . The effect on morphisms is identical to $\operatorname{PD}_{X}$ , and isomorphisms of filtered quantizations are defined similarly.

Let $\Gamma$ be a reductive group acting by graded Poisson automorphisms on $\mathbb{C}[X]$ . We say that $(\mathcal{A},B,i)$ is a $\Gamma$ -quantization if it is equipped with a $\Gamma$ -action such that $(\mathcal{A},B,i)$ is a Poisson $\Gamma$ -deformation of $\mathbb{C}[X]$ , and the $\Gamma$ -action on $B$ is trivial.

Isomorphisms of $\Gamma$ -quantizations are the isomorphisms respecting the $\Gamma$ -action, and the functor of $\Gamma$ -equivariant filtered quantizations

(13.7)

$\displaystyle\operatorname{Q}_{X,\Gamma}:\textbf{SFAlg}\longrightarrow\textbf{Set}$

associates to each split filtered graded algebra $B$ the set of isomorphism classes of Poisson $\Gamma$ -deformations with base $B$ .
card.label: Example 13.2

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and finite $W$-algebras of classical type
paper.abstract: We introduce parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians of types AI and AII, interpolating between the R-matrix presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. Then we formulate and provide parabolic presentations for the shifted twisted Yangians. We define quotient algebras known as truncated shifted twisted Yangians and equip them with baby comultiplications, generalizing the work of Brundan and Kleshchev. PBW bases for all (truncated) shifted twisted Yangians of type AI and AII are established along the way. Applying the theory of universal equivariant quantizations of conic symplectic singularities we show that the truncated twisted shifted Yangian is isomorphic to the finite $W$-algebra which quantizes a suitable Slodowy slice. This provides a presentation of the finite $W$-algebra associated with every even nilpotent element in type {\sf B} and {\sf C}, as well as every nilpotent element with two Jordan blocks in type {\sf D}. Finally we make a conjecture which would supply presentations in the remaining even cases in type {\sf D}.
